text:
dev_recruiter: Heads-up — the panel for candidate #8472 on Tue 10am has a conflict. @alex_t can you still make it? If not we need a swap and a quick debrief reminder sent after the loop.

alex_t: Sorry, I have a calendar conflict, can’t do 10am. I can do 11:30 or any time after 3pm that day.

emma_chen: I can cover 10am if someone else can take my 3pm slot that afternoon.

chris_k: I can move my 3pm to 11:30 — prefer avoid heavy context switching but happy to help.

dev_recruiter: Amazing, ok let’s do this: emma covers 10am, chris moves to 11:30, alex drops out. @sarah_m — can you confirm you’ll still join panel (you were backup)? Also quick Q: when scoring the rubric, do we use 1-4 or 1-5 for the "system design" section?

sarah_m: I’m on for backup, can join at 10 if needed. For the rubric, we use 1-4. The rubric doc at <https://docs.internal/recruiting/rubrics> has the table under "Engineering IC" but I can paste the bit here if helpful.

dev_recruiter: Please paste — want to make sure everyone uses same scale. Also request: after interview please add brief debrief notes in the candidate thread and set a quick sync (15m) if there’s disagreement.

emma_chen: Rubric snippet:```
System Design: 1 = inadequate, 2 = basic, 3 = good, 4 = exceptional.
Coding: 1-4 same scale.
Culture Add: 1-4 same scale.
Pass threshold = average >= 2.75
```

chris_k: Thanks. Quick clarification: do we collapse "System Design" and "Architecture" into one score or treat them separately? I remember seeing both headers.

sarah_m: We collapsed them last quarter — one combined "System Design" score. Architecture specifics go into notes (examples, tradeoffs).

dev_recruiter: Great — so plan: emma covers 10am, chris moves to 11:30, alex out. @alex_t can you confirm you’ll mark yourself as unavailable on the calendar? calendar-bot: Event updated: Candidate 8472 — Panel (10:00-11:00) now includes emma_chen; 11:30 slot updated to chris_k.

alex_t: Done — updated my calendar, sorry for the shuffle.

emma_chen: One more ask — can someone ping the hiring manager after the interview if we need an extra follow-up? I’ll add a note in the debrief but might want a quick sync if notes are mixed.

dev_recruiter: Yes — I’ll ping the hiring mgr in the candidate thread. Also reminder: use the debrief template, copy paste scoring table, and tag @hiring-manager and @recruiting. Short bullets only.

chris_k: Sounds good. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sarah_m: If anything changes I’ll flag here.

dev_recruiter: Closing loop — calendar updated, rubric clarified (1-4, system design combined), debrief process confirmed. Thanks team!"
